messages:
emma: Tiny bug report from the sample-app onboarding: when `jsonMode` + SDK `retry` are enabled, the function call payload sometimes arrives as a string and fails server schema validation. Quick repro below.

emma: Repro: `client.generate({ jsonMode: true, function_call: { name: 'log_event', payload: { level: 'info' } }, retry: { retries: 1 } })`. First try OK, retry shows `payload` as a string.

raj: can you paste the outgoing log from the local http logger? suspect the retry code is re-serializing an already-stringified body.

emma: log (sanitized):
`OUT -> { path: '/v1/generate', body: '{"model":"r-1","function_call":"{\"name\":\"log_event\",\"payload\":\"{\\\"level\\\":\\\"info\\\"}\"}" }' }'`

linda: that's double-stringified. The retry wrapper does JSON.stringify on the whole request and then uses that string to build the retry request again. Need a defensive clone when creating the replay request.

henry: minimal fix: when scheduling a retry, store a deep-cloned object (structuredClone or lodash.cloneDeep) instead of the serialized string. Add unit test: mock fetch returns 500 once and assert server receives an object `payload`.

ci-bot: test-runner: failing -> `sdk/retry.spec.ts` needs a case for nested function payload types preserved across retries.

raj: also add a dev-time warning if `jsonMode` && retry > 0 to surface this to new users until patch ships. Make it opt-in behind DEBUG.

emma: I'll open a small PR with clone + test + quickstart note. pairing welcome.
